## 🌴 Neon Coast — a limited-time makeover
- To celebrate a certain long-awaited trip to the sunny coast, Hanami is wearing a neon Vice-City sunset for the week — palms, synthwave sun and all
- The whole launcher and the in-game overlay get the treatment: hot pink, cyan and sunset gradients
- It switches itself back to normal automatically after about a week — no action needed
- Not feeling it? Settings › 🌴 Neon Coast toggles it off (or back on) any time while it lasts
